profile.headline: Engineering Manager at Pinterest
profile.summary: Building software that inspires you to live your best life

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Currently owning API & Android Development for Inclusive Product & Search features
- Built Native Checkout on Android enabling Pinners to shop on Pinterest
- Added the ability to shop on Ideas, Pins & Boards on Android
- Won the Engineering Citizen award for creating and running the onboarding process for new hires and engineers seeking to learn Android
- Work cross-functionally with designers, product managers, and engineers across a variety of product and platform teams to develop numerous features and improvements across the Android application
- Re-built the new and improved report content flow in React Native for cross-platform usage
- Improved and certified content logging platform on Android and worked cross-functionally to ensure parity across platforms in preparation for IPO
- Worked with designers and product managers to reimagine core gestures on the Pinterest product
- Successfully mentored four summer interns
- Co-founded Todos Pincluidos , the Latinx Employee Resource Group at Pinterest and grew it to over 200 members

positions.title: Android Engineering Contract
positions.description:
Small Ramp Up Project : Slack Check in App which notifies your team when you are in close proximity of the office buildings. 
Project 1: Worked in on an agile team to build an app which aggregates all photos with a specific hashtag on multiple social media networks and puts them in one album for all attendees to share, add to and edit. Also allows users to upload individual photos, flag photos for removal and print photos. 
Project 2: Client == P&G Febreeze: IoT app which syncs to a smart Febreeze Connect device and allows the user to control the intensity of the scent from anywhere in the world. In preparation for integration with Google Nest Devices.

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description: Access Code produces high quality Android developers through a 9-month curriculum developed and taught by leading Android experts from companies such as Google, TouchLab, and Adobe. Accepting only 5% of applicants, the highly selective program prepares graduates with both comprehensive technical training in Android as well as an immersive entrepreneurial and product oriented learning.

company.name: Access Code Fellowship, Coalition for Queens

positions.title: Intern Supervisor
positions.description:
•	Coordinated and ensured the financial oversight and financial health of the allotted transportation budget. 
•	Reviewed and matched applications for Host families and children with special needs.
•	Facilitated presentations and workshops in schools throughout the New York City area. 
•	Trained and supervised incoming interns.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•	Created an interactive Microsoft Access database for hundreds of employees. 
•	Worked with managers to successfully manage payment accounts between clients and their customers.
•	Maintained close connection with branches across the country to provide exceptional and accurate records to clients.

honors.title: Member
honors.issuer: Issued by Chi Alpha Epsilon National Honor Society

organizations.name: Omega Phi Beta Sorority Incorporated
organizations.description:
•	Managed and administered the organization, and served as facilitator of weekly executive board meetings.
•	Served as a liaison between the Undergraduate and National Chapters and the National Council.        
•	Organized the Annual On Campus Breast Cancer Walk.
•	Directed chapter events, intake, and development.

organizations.name: R.E.A.C.H.
organizations.description:
•	Raised awareness about issues College students currently face through social media outlets and campus initiatives.
•	Coordinated and Hosted Educational forums to inform students about risky sexual behavior and safe ways to indulge in sexual activities.
•	Designed informative displays to present to the General Student body.
